name: Update Rental Application

pathParams.name: rentalApplicationId

attributes.name: StatusReason
attributes.description: The reason for the denied or canceled rental application. Required when Status is "denied", optional when Status is "canceled". Not applicable for other statuses; will remain null for approved, decision_pending, etc.

responseFields.name: Id
responseFields.description: Unique identifier of the updated rental application
